integrity: Two source-independent mathematical implementations replay the same finite invariant directly from the nine public Pauli generators, one using ranks and the other enumerating each local Pauli. Earlier reported code parameters are credited and not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: No classification of all codes with these parameters.
This is an exact finite combinatorial census, not an infinite-family proof.
The result is for known-location qubit erasures rather than unknown errors or approximate decoding.
No independent mathematical or publication-priority audit.
scientific_scope: The nine published generators of one specific 20-qubit rank-9 \([[20,11,4]]\) stabilizer; four-erasure logical-support dimension histogram and exact known-location Bernoulli erasure reliability.
title: Exact four-erasure logical-support spectrum of a \([[20,11,4]]\) stabilizer code
